---
name: Feature or expansion idea
about: Describe an outcome for the shared game before implementation.
labels: needs-triage
---

## Desired outcome

What should the player or contributor be able to do? Give an example.

## Boundaries

What existing behavior should this build on? What can wait?

## Decisions to make

Your agent can help align this with the game docs, propose a spec and testing seams, and plan small tickets. Record owner approval or delegation before marking implementation ready.
